name: AnyPS5
description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows

issues.title: Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut (PPSA02225, Windows): black frames despite continuing draw and presentation activity
perf(agc): the queue-0 draw committer bounds draw-heavy titles on the CPU — is parallel draw recording planned?
AGC: run mesh-path draws on devices without mesh shaders through a compute pass and an indexed draw

Recompiler: a T# reached through two loads after a dynamically indexed read (pointer → pointer → T#, pointer → V# → buffer → T#) stops Ratchet & Clank (PPSA01474) and Guardians of the Galaxy (PPSA01748)
PPSA28997: presents pure-black frames after the studio logo, stalled following level1 asset loads
AGC: storage image access to depth/stencil surface 0x201a800000 is not implemented

Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart (PPSA01474): the compute shader whose s_swappc_b64 calls a computed target becomes a 2.5M-word SPIR-V module that RADV cannot compile (nir_opt_copy_prop_vars grows past 16 GB; Mesa 25.2.8 and 26.2.6)
